nEn: Zhang Qian's Mission to the Western Regions
dir: 西汉 → 西域（陆上丝路）
dirEn: Western Han → the Western Regions (overland Silk Road)
detail: 传出丝绸、漆器、冶铁；传入葡萄、苜蓿、胡桃与良马。
detailEn: Brought out silk, lacquer and iron-casting; brought in grapes, alfalfa, walnuts and fine horses.

nEn: Ban Chao in the Western Regions
detail: 投笔从戎，复通丝路，遣甘英西使大秦（罗马）。
detailEn: Cast aside the pen for the sword, reopened the Silk Road and sent Gan Ying toward Rome.

whoEn: Emperor Ming of Han, Kasyapa Matanga
detail: 白马驮经，传入佛教、佛经与造像。
detailEn: Scriptures arrived on white horses, bringing Buddhism, sutras and Buddhist art.

detail: 取回佛经六百余部，著《大唐西域记》。
detailEn: Returned with 600+ scriptures and wrote the Great Tang Records on the Western Regions.

detail: 六次东渡，传出佛法、建筑、医药与书法。
detailEn: After six attempts, brought Buddhism, architecture, medicine and calligraphy to Japan.

detail: 带回律令、文字、建筑与典章，深刻影响日本。
detailEn: Carried back law codes, writing, architecture and institutions that shaped Japan.

dir: 中国 ↔ 东南亚·印度洋
dirEn: China ↔ Southeast Asia & the Indian Ocean
detail: 传出瓷器、茶叶、丝织；传入香料、珠宝、玻璃。
detailEn: Exported porcelain, tea and silk; imported spices, gems and glass.

detail: 游历东方，《马可·波罗游记》激发欧洲对东方的想象。
detailEn: His travelogue fired Europe's imagination of the East.

dir: 明 → 东南亚·印度洋·非洲
dirEn: Ming → Southeast Asia, the Indian Ocean & Africa
detail: 七下西洋，传出瓷器丝绸、册封贸易；传入香料、珍宝、长颈鹿。
detailEn: Seven voyages: porcelain, silk and tribute trade out; spices, treasures and giraffes in.

detail: 传入西学、历法、几何与世界地图，开启中西交流。
detailEn: Brought Western learning, astronomy, geometry and world maps, opening East–West exchange.

detail: 以茶易马，沟通汉藏与西南各族。
detailEn: Tea for horses — linking Han, Tibetan and southwestern peoples.
